description: This file manages plugin installation processes in a software project, including installing from directories, files, archives, and npm specs, with validation, safety checks, and runtime management.

methods.name: loadPluginInstallRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the plugin installation runtime module.

methods.name: validatePluginId
methods.description: Validates plugin ID format according to naming rules.

methods.name: matchesExpectedPluginId
methods.description: Checks if a plugin ID matches the expected ID, considering backward compatibility.

methods.name: ensureOpenClawExtensions
methods.description: Verifies that the plugin manifest includes openclaw extensions.

methods.name: installPluginDirectoryIntoExtensions
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a source directory into the extensions folder, handling target resolution and copying.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for plugin installation based on plugin ID.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallTarget
methods.description: Resolves the canonical install target directory for a plugin.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveInstallMode
methods.description: Determines whether to perform an install or update based on existing files.

methods.name: installBundleFromSourceDir
methods.description: Installs a plugin bundle from a source directory, validating manifest and scanning for safety.

methods.name: installPluginFromSourceDir
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a source directory, detecting native packages or bundles.

methods.name: detectNativePackageInstallSource
methods.description: Detects if a source directory contains a native package with valid openclaw extensions.

methods.name: installPluginFromPackageDir
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a package directory, validating manifest, version, and dependencies.

methods.name: installPluginFromArchive
methods.description: Installs a plugin from an archive file, extracting and processing the source.

methods.name: installPluginFromDir
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a directory path, resolving whether it's a directory or archive.

methods.name: installPluginFromFile
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a file path, performing safety scans and copying.

methods.name: installPluginFromNpmSpec
methods.description: Installs a plugin from an npm spec, handling download, validation, and extraction.

methods.name: installPluginFromPath
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a given path, determining if directory, archive, or file.
